architecture.description: Layering rules Axivion would enforce as architecture-as-code (see docs/qa/licensed-tools.md). Not evaluated by this repo's CI -- no Axivion license here.

rules.description: Onboard examples model embedded targets: they must not depend on QtNetwork or QtSql, which is what actually separates them from their offboard sibling.

A game may depend on games.common for LAN transport, but never on another game's directory, and not on any other industries.* component even though it now lives under industries/ -- it is structurally its own vertical, just without the onboard/offboard split.
Showcases are general-purpose demos: no dependency on industries/ (including industries/games/) at all.
